text:
olivia: quick sync — longcontext soak showed slow mem growth on 6 hosts, looks linked to KV cache slice fragmentation. profile attached inline.
chen: can you paste the metric trends? which hosts/instances?
olivia: host ids: i-0a1b2c3d,east-2; kv_frag_ratio: 0.32 -> 0.46 over 6h; kv_free_holes: +12k; paging spikes at ~1.2s. short dump:
```
# pprof top (kv-allocator)
heap_alloc: 3.1G
kv_frag_ratio: 0.46
most_alloc: slab_buddy: 420MB
hotspots: alloc_fragment_scan
```
mohit: thanks. my read: allocator's small-chunk bins are scattering smaller than typical reuse size, so reuse misses and we allocate new blocks -> fragmentation and paging. sounds like block-size mismatch with longcontext seq len.
emily: thought: adaptive blockpacking — bump min block from 256->512 for contexts >8k tokens so we avoid micro-churn. also consider dynamic reserve when tail-of-cache utilization drops below 60% :thinking_face:
dave: risk: bigger blocks increase internal waste for short requests. need workload-aware gating and rollout.
olivia: agree. also saw compaction spike in CPU during off-hours (cron compactor started), cost ~7% CPU. sample compaction log:
```
compact pass 2026-03-02T04:12:18Z: freed 58MB, scanned 1.2M slots, cpu 230ms
```
mohit: what if we do hybrid: keep small bins but allow 'packing windows' where we try to coalesce adjacent free slots into bigger allocations when reuse probability low? incremental packer instead of full compactor.
chen: can we simulate? I can run a scheduler-level emu with seq dist and occupancy to measure fragmentation ratio for different block sizes.
emily: perf metrics to watch: kv_frag_ratio, kv_allocate_rate, srv_p99_latency, page_fault_rate, compaction_cpu_pct.
olivia: proposal: run A/B on 10% traffic with two changes: A) min_block=512 + reserve_ratio 0.15; B) incremental packer enabled (background low-prio) + min_block=256. run 24h soak with longcontexts. target metrics and rollback thresholds in the PR.
dave: +1. can we add a canary threshold: if page_fault_rate > baseline*1.2 or srv_p99 > baseline*1.05 -> auto rollback.
mohit: I'll sketch proto patches for allocator and incremental packer. assigning to @mohit. chen will own the sim and perf harness. olivia will drive rollout.
infra-bot: perf-run started by @chen: job kv-frag-sim-3419994321 (ETA 2h) :rocket:
olivia: thanks all. I'll draft RFC with experiment matrix and add sample graphs. :eyes:
